role: Runs Second Spin, records & radio repair
tagline: Says one exact thing instead of five approximate ones.

judge.summary: Noor, 25, former city mixing engineer who runs the island record shop. Dry, precise, reserved, terrible at small talk, an expert listener. Secretly the anonymous voice of the island's 2 a.m. pirate radio show.
loves: listening to her answer and building on it
honesty about what you don't know
comfortable pauses and short sincere replies
being a little strange on purpose
real talk about music and why it matters to you
hates: talking about yourself without asking about her
